descriptionChirho: Intransitive and stative uses (Qal, Nifal/Hofal participle, adjective) describing a place or thing as being in a state of ruin or desolation.
Causative Hifil verbal uses meaning to bring a place or thing to ruin, to devastate or demolish.
Substantivized Hifil participle used as an agentive noun denoting a person or force that brings destruction.
